description: This is a striking wingback armchair with a bold geometric pattern. The upholstery features a tapestry-like design with a repeating motif of diamonds and zigzags in shades of golden yellow, muted orange, and soft grey. The chair has a high, winged back that curves gently to the sides, providing a sense of enclosure and comfort. It is supported by four slender, tapered wooden legs. A matching throw pillow with the same intricate pattern sits on the seat, enhancing the chair's inviting appeal. The overall design suggests a blend of traditional comfort with a contemporary, artistic flair.
